name: FreeCAD
title: Open-source parametric CAD
description: Drive FreeCAD from a conversation: create and edit parts, read the document, run FreeCAD Python through your approve step. Community server (neka-nat/freecad-mcp); the first rung toward designs that get built.

mcp.also: Needs FreeCAD with the freecad-mcp addon installed and its RPC server started inside FreeCAD (see the project's README).
mcp.guidance: FreeCAD is open with its addon; make changes through the FreeCAD tools in that live session, not by launching FreeCAD from the terminal. Read the document first, and do not save unless asked.
